pdf-optimizer.detail: LLM wrote partial repair that didn't satisfy all constraints

pdf-jpeg.detail: LLM used output.pdf extension instead of output.jpg. PdfToImage tries to create directory at output path — conflicts with existing output.pdf file. Output filename was not checked by any validator.

pdf-tiff.detail: LLM used .tif extension instead of .tiff. File.Exists('output.tif') returned false because plugin creates 'output.tiff'. Extension length mismatch.

deterministic_failures.cause: LLM used wrong file extension in output path. No validator checked for specific filename strings.
deterministic_failures.fix: Add REQUIRED literal-string constraint for exact output filename. Extend _validate_code_from_constraints to handle no-parenthesis patterns as literal string checks.

probabilistic_failures.cause: LLM non-determinism: same constraints produce valid code in some runs, failing code in others. Not caused by constraint changes.
probabilistic_failures.observed_runs: Passes in runs 1+4; fails in runs 2+3
probabilistic_failures.mitigation: Replay-assisted repair; few-shot patterns; retry logic

constraint_induced_failures.cause: REQUIRED: result validation pattern constraint checked for exact string 'File.Exists(outputPath) and result?.ResultCollection?.Count > 0'. LLM wrote semantically equivalent code that failed literal match.
constraint_induced_failures.fix: Removed the constraint in Sprint 9 (run 4). Generation rate jumped from 4/11 to 10/11.
constraint_induced_failures.lesson: Literal string REQUIRED constraints on validation patterns are brittle. Prefer FORBIDDEN constraints for banned APIs over REQUIRED constraints on implementation patterns.

convergence_metrics.convergence_trend: CONVERGING — run 4 has highest generation rate (91%) and highest absolute passes (8). Remaining 2 failures are deterministic (wrong filename extension), addressable by literal-string constraint.
